This section will hold one page per organization once a cited public source supports more than a name. This page does **not** write organizational histories.

Names below appear either in the commissioning issue or in public sources catalogued in this pass. Listing a name is not a claim about legal continuity.

| Name | Why the name appears here |
| --- | --- |
| BC Rehabilitation Society (also “BC Rehab”) | Named as creator of *Keys on Freedom* (commissioning issue, not independently confirmed). Independently cited on the 1990 ECPM manual ([Roeher / Salisbury bibliography](../sources/allenshea-1997-if-bibliography.qmd)) and in [Clay 1993](../sources/clay-1993-pearson.qmd) |
| Greater Vancouver Home Support Society | Named with BC Rehab on the 1990 ECPM manual citation |
| Canadian Paraplegic Association / BC Paraplegic Association / Spinal Cord Injury BC | Named in [Haw 1989](../sources/haw-1989-creekview-account.qmd), [SCI BC history](../sources/sci-bc-history.qmd), and the [CSIL workbook](../sources/sci-bc-csil-workbook.qmd) |
| Creekview Co-operative (False Creek / Granville Island) | Named in Haw 1989, Fayerman 2018, and SCI BC history. Later SCI BC writing uses “Creekside” |
| Ryan & Wiggins | Named with Patricia Ryan on the Creekview 202 evaluation in the commissioning issue only |
| British Columbia Ministry of Health / Ministry of Health Services | Named on the [2008 synthesis](../sources/wanted-2008-program-review.qmd), current [program page](../sources/gov-bc-csil-program-page.qmd), and [HCC policy manual](../sources/hcc-policy-manual-csil.qmd) |
| Home and Community Care Branch, Health Authorities Division | Named as the 2008 synthesis client on the inspected title page |
| James Murtagh Consulting | Named as preparer of the November 2008 synthesis |
| Individualized Funding Resource Centre Society | [Our Team](../sources/ifrc-our-team.qmd) and later CSIL training slides |
| Association of CSIL Employers | Named in the [2011 news release](../sources/bc-gov-news-2011-csil-rates.qmd) |

: Organizations named in catalogued public sources

Creekview is also treated as a [history placeholder](../history/creekview.qmd), because its legal form in 1985 is not settled on this site.

When you add an organization page, separate documented functions (cited) from later attributions, and link every claim to a [source record](../sources/index.qmd).
